basic_info.description:
This bright and inviting home offers spacious bedrooms, each filled with natural light, and a beautifully updated kitchen featuring stainless steel appliances, modern cabinetry, and contemporary finishes perfect for everyday cooking and entertaining.

-A fully renovated shared bathroom
-Updated shared kitchen
-Generous closet space throughout
-In-unit washer and dryer (shared, located in the garage)

-5-minute walk to Daly City BART for quick access to Downtown SF, the East Bay, and the South Bay
-7-minute walk to H Mart
-Close to City College of San Francisco, San Francisco State University (SFSU), Stonestown Galleria, Lake Merced, and the vibrant Ocean Avenue shops and restaurants

Additional Details:
-Pets permitted: $50 additional monthly rent per pet + $250 additional security deposit per pet
-Utilities: Split equally among all housemates
-No smoking
-Unfurnished

Lease term: Minimum 6 months

Note: If you plan to move out please let the property manager know 2 months before moving out.
